title: File Formats: CSV, JSON, Parquet & More

scenes.line1: Which file format should you use?
scenes.say: Which file format should you use for your pipeline? Does it really matter? Let’s break it down.

scenes.label: CSV/JSON
scenes.sub: Text-based, easy to read, but slow for big data.
scenes.say: CSV and JSON are text-based and easy to read, but they’re slow and inefficient for large-scale analytics.
Parquet and Avro are binary, columnar formats—perfect for analytics. Delta and Iceberg build on Parquet, adding ACID transactions, schema evolution, and even time travel.

scenes.title: Querying Parquet in Spark
scenes.say: For example, Spark reads Parquet files efficiently, making columnar queries super fast.

scenes.question: Should you use CSV for big data?
scenes.right: No—use Parquet, Delta, or Iceberg for speed and features.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Should you use CSV for big data? No—choose Parquet, Delta, or Iceberg for better speed and features.
